input.instruction: Answer the customer’s policy question using the supplied records and handbook. Complete the requested fields and provide a concise explanation. This is an informational request; propose no account or claim actions.

data.note: Not the item being asked about.

messages.text: There was smoke from an accidental kitchen fire on October 1. My roommate Dev’s television was damaged. It belongs entirely to Dev; I did not buy any part of it.
Is Dev listed as a named insured on an issued policy document? You also mentioned a camera in an earlier note.
No. We split the rent, but only I am listed on this policy. My own camera is fine; I am only asking about Dev’s TV.
Does sharing the apartment put Dev’s belongings on your policy?
That is the question. Does my renters policy cover Dev’s television because we share the apartment?
Please answer about that TV only. Do not add Dev as an insured and do not treat this as a claim denial paperwork step.

property_owner.description: Ownership category: named_insured for an owner listed in issued declarations, unnamed_roommate for a roommate owner not listed there, landlord for the building owner, or unknown when the relationship is unresolved.

property_scope.description: Scope conclusion for this particular item under the supplied ownership rule.

shared_rent_creates_insured_status.description: Whether sharing rent itself makes the roommate a named insured.
